sam: quick sync on the cross-path quota migration. sketching the safe rollout and anti-evasion checks.
reena: important we guarantee no customer-visible token accounting regressions.
diego: agreed. plan idea: keep legacy LeaseAPI as authoritative during rollout. add a tiny shim that forwards to ledger and emits X-Quota-Map header.
sam: shim header example: X-Quota-Map: lease1->ledgerA;shim=canary-01
reena: dedupe logic at ingress? we need concrete pseudocode for oncall.
sam: pseudocode:
```
if hdr := req.headers['X-Quota-Map']:
  if seen(req.id): return ACK_NO_CHARGE
  seen_set.add(req.id)
  forward(ledger)
else:
  forward(legacy)
```
diego: partial write failure: legacy success + ledger timeout -> treat legacy as source-of-truth and enqueue ledger write for retry.
sam: reconciliation job nightly; P1 alert if mismatch >0.2% for 24h. add dedupe_rate metric.
reena: abuse: clients switching endpoints to game quotas. add cross-path sketch counters keyed by client fingerprint; rule: >3x baseline QPS => probation and notify.
sam: ledger will emit X-Quota-Abuse: <0-100>. ingress uses score>65 to route to probation lane.
